attempts.notes: Parrot's own ANAFI USA spec page confirms the thermal sensor is a FLIR Boson (and the visible chain is two 1/2.4" 21MP sensors), but it does not name the visible-spectrum sensor vendor; the Sony IMX230 identification comes from Wikipedia's account of the base Anafi, which uses the same 1/2.4" 21MP camera, so it is not USA-model-specific.
